message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0), plus two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Additionally, there are 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck. 2. Deal 7 cards to each player. 3. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile. 4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a Wild Draw Four, the next player draws four cards and loses a turn). | | **Turn Play** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the color, number, or symbol of the top discard. If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction (in a 2‑player game it acts like Skip).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color cards; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach 500 points (or your chosen target) wins. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep a mix of colors** – It gives you more options to play. 2. **Save Wild Draw Fours** – Use them when you’re stuck or to finish a round. 3. **Watch the discard pile** – Knowing what’s coming can help you plan your next move. 4. **Challenge wisely** – Only challenge a Wild Draw Four if you’re sure the player had a matching color card. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
